items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: My uncle Marcus, he left from here. He never did come back here anymore. ... I don't know. Really? He might have another family somewhere out there. I don't know.

ctx.x: And my grandfather's sister was a guitarist. And they moved here after my grandfather died. My grandmother moved here, which I had an uncle, Marcus Teo. He was an also crying at us.
Never knew of him at all.
